description:
Opaque rotating refresh tokens for the JVM, implementing the NEBULA
    specification (the RFC 9700 refresh-token model): selector/verifier tokens
    that carry no claims, rotation on every use, reuse detection with family
    revocation, hashed storage, dual expiry clocks and optional sender
    (device) binding. JDK standard library only — no runtime dependencies —
    and callable unchanged from Kotlin and Scala.
